guestGone: The other player has left. You play on with the AI in their place.
pick: An exhibition game between two devices, each with its own screen and controls. One of you hosts; the other joins. For now both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi, and both must have the same copy of the game: reload first if in doubt. Nothing here counts.
cannot: This browser cannot join two devices directly.
hostDetail: The game runs on your device, with your team. You send the other player an invitation, they send a code back, and the puck drops.
joinDetail: The game runs on the host's device and you play in it from yours. You need the invitation the host sent.
hostSteps: Three steps: make the invitation and send it to the other player; they open it and send a code back; you put that code in here. Choose how you play first.
makeDetail: Makes a link that holds how to reach this device. It is good until you leave this screen. Send it by message, mail or any way you like.
hostCode: Send the invitation to the other player. When their answer comes back, paste it here.
joinSteps: Paste the invitation the host sent you. Your device then makes an answer to send back.
guestCode: Send this answer back to the host. The game starts by itself once they have put it in: stay on this screen.
copyByHand: Could not copy. Press and hold the text in the box, and copy it by hand.
pasteByHand: Could not read what was copied. Press and hold in the box, paste it there, then choose the row below.
noAnswer: There is no answer in the box yet.
noInvitation: There is no invitation in the box yet.
badCode: That is not a code from this game. Copy all of it and try again.
noJoin: The two devices could not find each other. Check both are on the same Wi-Fi, and start again with a new invitation.
failed: Could not set up a connection on this device.
otherBuild: The two devices have different copies of the game. Reload the game on both and try again.
